purpose: Implementation selection plan; not a generated market feed or fixed badge count.
pipeline: read current fixtures and supported market/price schema
expand valid types x supported periods x subjects x modeled lines
price from coherent existing synthetic models
deduplicate canonical aliases and validate renderer support
derive badge/detail/filters/slip from same normalized collection
report actual per-fixture and per-type coverage

profile_policy.compact: Use where event format or reliable support is limited. Preserve genuinely applicable types.
profile_policy.standard: Fully implement common team and period markets appropriate to the sport.
profile_policy.extended: Add supported advanced statistics, more meaningful alternate lines, and verified player markets.
profile_policy.assignment: fixture metadata and explicitly recorded capabilities, with fixture-id/version based deterministic demo variation; not arbitrary target numbers
profile_policy.count_targets_are: design ranges for rich examples, not universal quotas or observed site averages

soccer.line_rule: game-specific modeled center; quarter/half/integer support only when renderer and refund semantics exist; no negative total-goals lines
soccer.specific: to_qualify only with knockout context; use supported player templates with verified roster

basketball.line_rule: league-format dependent periods and per-game scoring model; varied alternate spread/total/team lines
basketball.specific: OT scope stored per market; apply supported player templates and combined-stat models with verified roster

baseball.line_rule: per-game run model; group innings distinct from a single inning; dedupe first-inning 0.5 total and NRFI/YRFI
baseball.specific: verified starter/batting roster required for pitcher/batter templates; no quarterback/quarter terminology

ice_hockey.line_rule: per-game goal model and supported alternate puck/total/team lines; exact settlement scope retained
ice_hockey.specific: player goals/points/shots need verified roster; saves need verified starting goalie

alias_notes: draw_no_bet equals asian_handicap_0 for identical scope
player_2_plus equals player_over_1.5 for identical statistic and scope

line_variation_guidance.meaning: Candidate line counts to choose from by fixture profile; every selected line needs a valid distinct modeled question and price. No forced padding.

coverage_reporting: For every catalog template, record implemented or excluded with reason; all eligible supported families should be considered within this batch. Do not declare research-only template files as completed UI.
data_constraints: no invented real-player identities or false team affiliations
do not represent synthetic odds or fixtures as live-feed data
